spec.assertion: Proves pierce is a gainPierce EFFECT on a shot/charge-keyed trigger, not the static top-level hasPierce flag; fails under the nearest-wrong 'hasPierce:true from t=0' and under a passive-trigger encoding. Also asserts inertness (no pierceDamagePct source in the control comp, so stripping it must be damage-identical).

it.skip — no StatKey exists for piercing RADIUS (pierceDamagePct is Pierce DAMAGE, a different mechanic) and the scope-lock boss is a single partless target, so radius has no observable payload. Belongs in unmodeled.skill1.

Proves the rider contributes ZERO at scope lock (single partless boss can never satisfy '2 or more enemies concurrently'). Discriminates by ADDING the nearest-wrong unconditional per-shot flatDamage 50.33% and showing baseline is >5% lower; plus a structural check that no committed block carries a 50.33 atkPct.

Proves a no-activation-clause damage line is modeled as an `interval`-triggered enemy-targeted rider in the skill bucket. Fails under burstCast-keyed (burst bucket, ~a handful of fires) and under shotFired (fires once per pull) — the test bounds the fire count strictly between 1 and the shot count. The interval SECONDS are ALWAYS-⚑ (kit-silent) so no cadence number is pinned; only shape + non-vacuity + teammate inertness.

Proves the instant is a burstCast-triggered enemy hit in the burst bucket with fbMajorApplied never true (verified fact: burst-cast damage lands before Full Burst opens). Fails under a fullBurstEnter re-key, which would stamp the +50% FB major.

Proves exactly ONE dot effect at atkPct 13.19 / intervalSec 1 / durationSec 10 / flavor 'sustained' / crit false, and that total sustained ticks ≤ burstCasts × 10. Fails under taxonomy #5 (a long DoT on a repeating/per-shot trigger multiplies), under a 131.9% instant fold, and under an unmeasured crit:true opt-in.

Proves maxAmmoFlat +6 (base ammo 6 → magazine doubles to 12), self-targeted, once per burst cast, on a wall-clock 15s window (expiresFrame set, durationShots undefined — contrast with skill1's ROUND-count duration). Fails under maxAmmoPct:6 (a near-no-op, tested explicitly as a counterfactual) and under dropping the line as 'defensive' (removal must strictly lower BOTH her total and her shot count — the mechanism is shots fired, not a stat multiplier).

fixtures: controlComp('nihilister', true) only — one baseline run plus one counterfactual run per discriminating claim (10 runs total, under the ~20-run budget). She is Burst II, so the control's B1 and B3 slots are mandatory: without a completable chain her burst never casts and every burst-slot assertion (158.59% instant, Burn, ammo buff) would be vacuous — hence the explicit fixture-sanity block asserting shots > 0, burstCasts > 0 and fullBurstStart > 0 before anything else. The fixed-B3 flag is left TRUE because none of her assertions read a stat the fixed B3 slot could confound (all deltas are self-scoped and measured against a same-fixture baseline). Deterministic (no seed) so every counterfactual delta is attributable to the patch alone.
gaps: it.skip: 'Piercing Radius ▲ 50% for 1 round(s)' — no piercing-RADIUS StatKey in the schema (pierceDamagePct is Pierce DAMAGE, a distinct mechanic) and the scope-lock boss is a single partless target, so radius has no observable payload. Record in unmodeled.skill1.

NOT it.skip but asserted-inert: skill1's 'hits 2 or more enemies concurrently → 50.33%' — unsatisfiable at scope lock (single partless boss). Tested as a positive inertness claim rather than skipped, because the nearest-wrong model (unconditional per-shot rider) is a large silent over-credit worth pinning against.

⚑ ALWAYS-FLAG (not testable): skill2's interval CADENCE. The kit gives the 112.64% line no activation clause and no period, so any seconds value is invented — the test asserts trigger SHAPE and fire-count bounds only, never a cadence number. Recipe: focus recording of nihilister solo, count skill-bucket popups per minute.

⚑ ALWAYS-FLAG (not testable): the SR cadence tuple (chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 datamine fields are known-unreliable). The ammo-buff delta test asserts only the SIGN of the shot-count change, never an absolute shot count, so it survives a cadence refit.
